Restore Zig 0.16.0 as the supported toolchain for stability.

## Changed

- Restore the implementation, build configuration, and tests from v0.1.7,
  before the Zig 0.17 migration.
- Require Zig 0.16.0 for source builds. Zig 0.17 is not supported by this version.
- Update dependencies to Chasen v0.1.4 and Chasen UI v0.1.4, using their Zig 0.16 releases.
- Restore the Zig 0.16-compatible flow-syntax dependency.
- Publish the restored implementation as v0.1.9; existing releases remain unchanged.

No new features are added. Linux x86_64 and macOS Apple Silicon binaries are
built and tested with Zig 0.16.0 in ReleaseSafe mode.

Full Changelog: https://github.com/hiroaqii/gitframe/compare/v0.1.8...v0.1.9
